title: Book One · Chapter 101: The Water Line Falls
story:
Their last test begins badly.

Ronan puts the flat boat in the basin. Mei checks the page. The water is at the marked line when they start.

They fetch the stones, then look at the water again. Now it is below the line.

“You poured some out,” Ronan says.

“I did not.”

“Then where did it go?”

Mei points under the table. The cloth is dark and wet. A small drop falls from the bottom of the basin.

Ronan lifts the boat out at once. Mei moves the book away. Neither tries to carry the full basin across the room.

They call Miss Wu. She asks the next table to step back. Then she puts an empty tub underneath the basin. They can hear each drop fall into it.

A tiny split is open near the basin's edge. People used this old bowl for many years. Miss Wu asks for a cloth. A school worker comes to help empty the basin.

Leo arrives with his group's boat.

“Has yours sunk already?”

“Our sea is leaking away,” Ronan says.

Leo looks beneath the table. “That is worse.”

The spare basin is smaller. Their flat boat fits in it. But there is less space at each end. Miss Wu looks at their page. “Will this test be the same as before?” she asks.

“The boat is the same,” Ronan says.

“The sides are closer,” Mei says.

They put the drawing beside the new basin. One end can easily touch the wall now. If the wall holds the boat, the boat may stay up. Then the wall is helping it.

They decide to test only the smaller paper model today. The teacher needs to borrow a larger basin first. Then they can test the flat boat. They want to do the test now. But they could get a false result in this basin. The wall could hold their boat up.

Ronan writes BASIN LEAKED on a scrap. Mei puts the date underneath. They put the scrap in their folder. It goes between the old tests and the blank page.

They try the smaller model empty first. Then they test it with one stone. A drop from someone's sleeve makes a wet ring on the table. Ronan checks the sleeve first this time. He does not blame the basin at once.

At the end, they help move the dry supplies. Those things must stay away from the damp area. The school worker took the broken basin away. “Thank you,” Miss Wu says. “You called me first. You left the heavy basin on the table.”

Ronan carries the stones back in a little cup. Leo carries the spare cloth. Mei puts the class book high on the shelf.

The children have not finished their boat tests. But their three small jobs help clear the room. Now it is ready for the next lesson.

On the way home, Ronan tells Mum about the leak. “Did anyone slip?” she asks. He says no.

“Good. What did your boat do?”

“We did not test it.”

“Then that is today's answer.”

At home, the kitchen basin is full of washing. Ronan leaves it alone. He opens his folder and reads the earlier page. The old results are still useful. The broken basin does not change those earlier results. He puts his yellow ruler beside the blank space. It will help him find his place next time.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- leak＝漏水（文中有leaking、leaked等形式）
- split＝裂缝
- spare＝备用的
- false result＝不真实的结果

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：tub＝桶状容器；sleeve＝袖子；supplies＝用品。

## 读句提示

**Did anyone slip?**

有人／滑倒了吗？使用直接问句，不用asks whether。

## 理解问题

1. 他们怎样发现问题来自盆而不是船？
2. 换成小盆后，为什么平船测试需要等待？
